name: tick_id
description: Unique primary key for market tick fact record

name: tick_date
description: Tick event calendar date - Partition key

name: event_timestamp
description: High-precision microsecond UTC timestamp of market print

name: ticker
description: Instrument symbol - FK to dim_tickers, Clustering key

name: asset_class
description: Asset class (EQUITY, FX, COMMODITY, CRYPTO, ETF) - Clustering key

name: mid_price
description: Mid-point price between bid and ask

name: relative_spread_bps
description: Relative spread expressed in basis points (spread / mid * 10000)

name: volume
description: Last traded contract or share volume

name: is_crossed_quote
description: Validation flag indicating whether bid exceeds ask

name: _raw_record_hash
description: SHA-256 lineage fingerprint from streaming ingestion tier

name: _ingested_at
description: Audit timestamp when record was loaded into BigQuery
